pages.text: $(bold)How to obtain$():$(li)Get $(bold)Molten Dragonsteel (Ice)$() by smelting Dragonsteel (Ice) Ingots in the Smeltery (made from Ice and Fire's $(bold)Ice Dragon$() materials)$(li)At the Casting Table, pour $(bold)90 mB$() of Molten Dragonsteel (Ice) (1 ingot) to make Dragonsteel (Ice) material$(br2)Tier: $(bold)T3$().

$(bold)Innate traits$():$(li)$(l:traits/trait_dragonsteel_ice)Dragonsteel Ice$(): on hit, applies a frost effect that greatly slows the target and deals continuous freezing damage, while spreading frost around it$(br2)One of the three dragonsteel variants, leaning toward crowd control and sustained damage.
